title: Yufeng Pagoda above the Willows
notes: Late-afternoon sun catches Yufeng Pagoda on Jade Spring Hill, rising above a bank of willows, seen from Beiwu Park.
lens: Tamron 25-200mm F/2.8-5.6 Di III VXD G2
alt: The slender, many-eaved Yufeng Pagoda on top of a wooded hill against a clear pale sky, with sunlit willows filling the foreground.
caption: Yufeng Pagoda above the Willows
